title: Remove the unreachable RpcCapacity stage from native relay 5xx diagnostics
outcome: Native relay 5xx diagnostic stages describe reachable recorded failures without implying that 429 capacity refusals appear in this history.
acceptance: Remove the unreachable RpcCapacity variant and assignment while preserving the existing 429 RPC-limit response, its bounded refusal reason and all relay wire, retry and authority behaviour.
Relevant existing behavioural checks and the normal review/gate evidence accompany the cleanup; add no enum/prose-pinning test.
